title: Bitcoin=No Utility, Just A Savings Account; Until It Tanks!
description:
Bitcoin is often called digital gold—but is that all it really is?
With slow transaction speeds, high fees during congestion, and limited real-world payment adoption, many are starting to question whether Bitcoin is truly a utility asset… or just a speculative savings vehicle.
In this short, we break down the difference between store of value vs real utility, why speed and scalability matter, and how assets like XRP are designed for actual global payment use cases.
Is Bitcoin the future of money—or just a temporary store of value?
